name: Celebrating Birthdays
overview: Scripture records instances of birthday celebrations, such as Pharaoh's feast on his birthday (Genesis 40:20) and Job's sons feasting on their special days (Job 1:4), indicating that marking these occasions was known in biblical times. However, God’s people are instructed not to follow the customs of surrounding nations (Leviticus 18:3), emphasizing the importance of distinguishing their practices. The blessings and choices presented by God (Numbers 6:24; Deuteronomy 30:15) remind believers to seek life and righteousness above mere tradition, grounding any celebration in a heart that honors God’s will.
